summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB bundled payload
details: @or-sdk/account-settings@1.3.7 declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases and then invokes it (via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`) against a locally-shipped 727KB `math_init.js` bundle. Both files are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses `_0x`-prefixed identifiers with string-array/object-property indirection, and `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle with a `WV8StW` array-shuffle routine and a large opaque numeric string table. The install-time behavior does not build or configure a native addon and does not correspond to the package's stated purpose (an 'account-settings' SDK) — its sole effect at install is to pull a second runtime and execute an unreadable payload under it, which bypasses static scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. Installing or requiring this version therefore runs opaque, publisher-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
